# API errors

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-docs.mjs from docs/contracts/auth/errors.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every error body is JSON `{"error": code, "message": "English sentence"}`. Branch on the `error` code, never on the message. The catalogue below is the auth and account contract (`docs/contracts/auth/errors.json`); the same codes are shared by the backup and restore routes. Other areas (AI, journal, library) document their own codes in the README.

| Code | Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `bad_request` | 400 | Malformed or incomplete request body. |
| `unauthorized` | 401 | No session, or the token is unknown, idle for 90 days or revoked, or the access token is unknown, expired or revoked. The client drops its token and shows sign-in. |
| `bad_credentials` | 401 | Wrong username or password at sign-in (anonymous step, not a lost session). |
| `forbidden` | 403 | The route needs an administrator. |
| `registration_closed` | 403 | Registration is closed: only an administrator creates accounts (the instance already has users and the mode is closed). |
| `invite_invalid` | 403 | The invite link is unknown, expired, used up or revoked (one code and one body for all four, so a guesser learns nothing). |
| `email_required` | 422 | The email policy is required and no address was sent. |
| `email_disabled` | 422 | The email policy is off and an address was sent. |
| `invalid_email` | 422 | Not a usable email address (one @, a dotted domain, at most 254 bytes). |
| `email_taken` | 409 | Another account already uses that email address (compared case-insensitively). |
| `mail_unavailable` | 409 | The setting needs a working mail server and none is configured. |
| `invalid_host` | 422 | The mail server host name is empty, too long, or has a scheme, path or space. |
| `smtp_host_blocked` | 422 | The mail server address is never allowed (metadata, link-local) or private and QINQIN_SMTP_ALLOW_PRIVATE is off. |
| `invalid_port` | 422 | The mail server port is outside 1-65535. |
| `invalid_tls` | 422 | The connection security is not starttls, tls or none. |
| `credentials_need_tls` | 422 | A user name was given with connection security none: credentials never travel in clear text. |
| `invalid_public_url` | 422 | The public URL is not an absolute http(s) address without path, query, fragment or login. |
| `password_reentry_required` | 422 | The server, port, security, user name or public URL changed (or the stored password cannot be read): the mail password must be sent again. |
| `recipient_required` | 422 | A test mail needs a recipient and the account has no email address. |
| `secret_unavailable` | 409 | QINQIN_SECRET is missing or invalid, so a secret (mail password, two-factor secret) cannot be stored. |
| `smtp_test_failed` | 502 | The test mail failed. The body carries category (connect, blocked, tls, auth, sender, recipient, timeout, protocol) and smtpCode when the server gave a reply code; never the server's text. |
| `code_invalid` | 403 | A one-time code (email code, authenticator code, recovery code) is wrong. The emailed-code and sign-in second steps carry attemptsLeft; the re-authentication checks before an account or administrator action do not (their budget is per user). 403 on routes with a session, 401 on the anonymous sign-in steps (login/mfa, email-login/verify), so the client never mistakes it for a lost session. |
| `challenge_expired` | 403 | The code challenge is gone: expired (10 minutes), spent, or tried 5 times. Start again (401 on the anonymous sign-in steps, 403 with a session). |
| `nothing_to_verify` | 409 | Resend asked for a code but the account has no unverified email address. |
| `setup_expired` | 409 | The authenticator setup (10 minutes) expired before its first code was confirmed. Start the setup again. |
| `not_enabled` | 409 | The method the request changes is not on (disable or regenerate without an authenticator). |
| `email_unverified` | 409 | The email method needs a verified address: confirm it first. |
| `mfa_required` | 409 | On an account route: turning this method off would leave the account without a second step while the administrator requires one. (On the sign-in route the same code is a 200 status word, see login-responses.json.) |
| `method_unavailable` | 409 | The second-step method asked for (an emailed code) is not available for this account or instance. |
| `email_login_unavailable` | 409 | Sign-in by emailed code is switched off (or the server has no mail): use the password. |
| `password_login_required` | 403 | Two-step sign-in is required and this account has no authenticator, so an emailed code alone cannot sign in: use the password. |
| `mail_outage` | 503 | Sign-in refused (fail closed): the account's second step is an emailed code and the server cannot send mail. Retry later; an administrator can fix Admin, Email or run qinqin recover --reset-mfa. |
| `last_admin` | 409 | The change would leave the instance without an active administrator. |
| `self_target` | 409 | An administrator tried to disable or delete their own account, or reset their own two-step sign-in, through the admin routes (Settings, Account does these). |
| `invalid_request` | 422 | A well-formed request the server will not do (for example cancelling a forced password change). |
| `token_invalid` | 400 | A reset link is unknown, expired, already used or belongs to a disabled account (one code and one body for all of them). |
| `confirm_mismatch` | 422 | The typed confirmation (the username) does not match the account being deleted. |
| `password_required` | 422 | An administrator action that needs the acting administrator's own password (the list in README.md, Administration: e.g. grant admin, delete another user, change an address, save the mail settings, lower a sign-in protection) came without currentPassword. An administrator with an authenticator also sends code (403 code_invalid). On PUT /api/admin/settings/smtp the same code can also mean the mail account's user name needs a password; the message says which. |
| `invalid_invite` | 422 | An invite parameter is out of range (uses 1-100, expiry 1-90 days, note at most 100 characters). |
| `invalid_setting` | 422 | A settings value outside its vocabulary. |
| `account_disabled` | 403 | Right password, but an administrator disabled the account. |
| `password_change_required` | 403 | The session must choose a new password before anything else; the token stays valid. |
| `mfa_enrollment_required` | 403 | The session must enrol a second factor before anything else; the token stays valid. |
| `wrong_password` | 403 | The re-entered current password is wrong. 403, never 401, so the client keeps its token. |
| `current_password_required` | 403 | The current password was not sent but this session must give it (everything except the session born from the temporary-password login). Refused before any attempt is counted; show the field. |
| `export_running` | 409 | An export of the user's data is already streaming (backup contract). Try again when it has finished. |
| `restore_running` | 409 | A restore of the user's data is running (or an export is refused because one is). Poll the stage; nothing can be started beside it. |
| `backup_running` | 409 | An administrator's whole-server backup is already running; one at a time. |
| `stage_not_ready` | 409 | The uploaded backup is still being checked, was refused or was already used; apply only when the status is ready. |
| `unresolved_entries` | 409 | The backup refers to words this server does not have; send "unresolved": "drop" to restore without them (the report lists them first). |
| `unsupported_media_type` | 415 | The restore upload must be sent as application/zip. |
| `backup_too_large` | 413 | A backup upload above 128 MiB, or an archive beyond the entry, line or expanded-size caps (also a stage error code). |
| `restore_busy` | 409 | Another restore is being applied on this server (only one at a time; a restore holds the database write lock about 30 s per million events). Retry-After is 30; try again later. |
| `backup_too_many_events` | 422 | Stage error code: the backup holds more than 2,000,000 study events, which a restore refuses. |
| `backup_invalid` | 422 | Stage error code, not an HTTP status: the uploaded file is not a valid qinqin backup (hostile or damaged zip, bad checksum, unknown field) or cannot be restored here (language not set up). status carries the stage, the HTTP answer of the status route is 200. |
| `backup_version_unsupported` | 422 | Stage error code: the archive's formatVersion is not one this server reads (formats are never guessed). |
| `backup_too_large_to_restore` | 422 | Export refused: the archive would exceed what a restore accepts (128 MiB compressed, 2 GiB expanded, 64 MiB per book), so no download link is issued. |
| `insufficient_storage` | 507 | Admin server backup: the data volume lacks room for a snapshot of the database (database + WAL + 64 MiB). |
| `not_found` | 404 | No such object (or it belongs to someone else). |
| `username_taken` | 409 | The username exists (compared case-insensitively). |
| `too_large` | 413 | Request body above the route's cap. |
| `weak_password` | 422 | The new password breaks the policy (10-256 characters, not the username). message names the rule. |
| `invalid_username` | 422 | The username breaks the policy (3-32 letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen; no @). message names the rule. |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | Too many attempts; Retry-After carries the wait in whole seconds. Never retry automatically. |
| `internal` | 500 | Unexpected server error; nothing was changed. |
| `busy` | 503 | The password-hash gate is saturated; Retry-After is 2. Never retry automatically. |
| `token_not_allowed` | 403 | Access tokens cannot be used on this route (account, sign-in, admin, backup, AI, journal, workspace management, the token routes themselves). Use a signed-in session. |
| `token_read_only` | 403 | The access token is read-only and the route writes. |
| `token_workspace` | 403 | The access token is limited to one workspace and the request is not inside it: ?workspace= is missing or names another workspace, or the route spans workspaces or addresses objects by id. |
| `token_limit` | 409 | 20 live access tokens already; revoke one first. Expired tokens do not count. |
| `invalid_token_request` | 422 | Name (1-64 characters), scope (read or write) or expiry (1-365 days) out of range; the message names the field. |
